title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Revelation 5: the book sealed with seven seals, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Lamb with seven horns, and the new song.

questions.text: What did John see in the right hand of him who sat on the throne?
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:1 says he saw a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

answers.text: A book sealed shut with seven seals
Seven golden stars
A sharp two-edged sword
A golden harp and a trumpet

questions.text: What did the mighty angel proclaim with a loud voice?
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:2 says the angel proclaimed, "Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?"

answers.text: "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty"
"Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?"
"Come up here and see what must happen"
"Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed"

questions.explanation: Revelation 5:4 says he wept much because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it.

answers.text: The book had been taken away from him
The elders would not speak a word to him
No one was found worthy to open the book or look in it
The seven seals had already been broken

questions.text: How does one of the elders describe the one who has overcome?
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:5 says the elder calls him the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, who has overcome.

answers.text: The Alpha and the Omega, the Almighty
The Beginning of God's creation
The Faithful and True Witness of God
The Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David

questions.text: What did the Lamb have, standing as though it had been slain?
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:6 says the Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes.

answers.text: Seven horns and seven eyes
Six wings and eyes within
A golden sash and a sword
A crown of gold and a harp

questions.text: What are the seven eyes of the Lamb, according to the text?
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:6 says the seven eyes are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

answers.text: The seven assemblies that are in Asia
The seven seals upon the book
The seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth
The angels of the seven assemblies

questions.text: What did the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders each have?
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:8 says each one had a harp, and golden bowls full of incense.

answers.text: A crown of gold and a white stone
A harp and golden bowls full of incense
A trumpet and a sharp sword
A palm branch and a burning lamp

questions.text: What does the text say the golden bowls of incense are?
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:8 says the golden bowls full of incense are the prayers of the saints.

answers.text: The works of the assemblies
The words of the prophecy
The songs of the elders
The prayers of the saints

questions.text: What does the new song say he made them to be for God?
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:9-10 says the new song tells him he made us kings and priests to our God, and that we will reign on the earth.

answers.text: Kings and priests
Witnesses to the nations
Pillars in the temple
Angels of the assemblies

questions.text: What did the four living creatures say at the close of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:14 says the four living creatures said, "Amen!" and then the elders fell down and worshiped.

answers.text: "Holy!"
"Come!"
"Amen!"
"Worthy!"
